lines.text: The checkout fix is scheduled for 17:00. Our biggest customer is waiting before opening their weekend sale.
The fix is on staging. It also adds the new payment-status column. Waiting for the last test run.
One retry test charged the same order twice. Only happened once in ten runs, but I haven't found the cause.
The old app version can't read the new status values. Rolling back the app alone won't be enough. I'm the only on-call engineer tonight.
Their current checkout fails for some customers, so waiting also has a cost. Could we enable the fix for just that customer?
We have a customer-level feature flag, but we haven't tested payment retries with it enabled.
@Alex I need a go/no-go and a next step before the customer call. What can we safely commit to?
